create.name: Chelsea Pottenger
create.bio:
Chelsea Pottenger is a Sydney mindfulness and meditation teacher and the founder of EQ Minds, a company that brings wellbeing training into workplaces. She holds a postgraduate qualification in psychology and is accredited as a mindfulness and meditation coach. She came to this work after a hard stretch of her own following the birth of her daughter, when she rebuilt her daily life around simple practices and later retrained so she could teach them. She has acted as an ambassador for Australian mental wellbeing charities.

Much of her teaching happens in offices and on conference stages, where she gives talks and half-day sessions on emotional intelligence, focus and speaking with confidence, often alongside her husband, Jay Pottenger. Her style mixes plain-language brain science with breath work, journalling and short guided sits that busy people can fit into a working day. Her book The Mindful High Performer came out with Murdoch Books in 2022, followed by a 66-day prompt journal. She also records ten-minute meditations for the EQ Minds YouTube channel and for Insight Timer, where she has courses on setting goals with a vision board and on helping young children grow steady and resilient.

courses.title: Emotional Intelligence Workshop Series
courses.description: Two interactive team workshops built on Daniel Goleman's model of emotional intelligence. The first looks at noticing and steadying your own reactions, the second at reading others and working well together.

courses.title: Focus and Productivity Training Workshop
courses.description: A half-day session for teams on planning the day, setting boundaries and cutting down digital distraction. Short mindfulness practices are used to bring attention back when it drifts.

courses.title: Mindful Communication & Public Speaking Workshop
courses.description: A workshop for teams on shaping a message, telling stories and using voice and body language with ease. Participants practise and get personal feedback on how they come across.

courses.title: Vision Board: Find Your Purpose & Achieve Your Goals
courses.description: A ten-day Insight Timer course with a short lesson each day. It moves through visualisation, a review of the main areas of life, goal setting and spotting limiting beliefs, ending with your own vision board.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Raising Resilient Children
courses.description: A ten-day Insight Timer course for parents and carers of children up to about eleven. Topics include mindfulness for families, routines, play, affection and looking after yourself as a parent.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Chelsea Pottenger on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Short guided meditations and mindfulness practices for work and home, made with EQ Minds, plus two paid courses. The single tracks are free to hear.

free_resources.title: Meditations with Chelsea Pottenger
free_resources.description: A free ten-minute guided meditation on the EQ Minds website. It offers a short pause to settle and reset in the middle of a busy day.

Email info@eqminds.com is the EQ Minds company inbox (Cloudflare-obfuscated on the contact page, decoded); flagging as a brand inbox.
EQ Minds is a corporate wellbeing company whose branding is built around mental health; the spiritual angle is light (mindfulness and meditation). A human may want to confirm she fits the directory.
YouTube videos are on the EQ Minds channel; most guided meditations appear to be voiced by Chelsea, but some EQ Minds content is by Jay Pottenger, so a quick listen is worth doing.
Possible duplicate: Jay Pottenger co-presents EQ Minds; he is not on Insight Timer as far as seen, so not listed.
Tier set to local_hero at review: the 92K EQ Minds Instagram is a company account shared with her husband, so not counted (with it she would be luminary).
